text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, cisatracurium besylate is not on FDA's drug shortage list. FDA records show the product status is "To Be Discontinued" with no date provided. Current inventory across three sites totals 188 vials. Corvale East holds 39 vials at 3.5 per day for 11.2 days on hand. Corvale General holds 126 vials at 4.1 per day for 31 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 23 vials at 0.8 per day for 29.6 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include cisatracurium besylate as of 2026-10-21. The agency's status field reads "To Be Discontinued since -" with no effective date listed.

Our position: Supply is adequate at Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside. Corvale East has limited coverage at 11.2 days. No shortage exists today, but the discontinuation status warrants proactive sourcing to prevent future gaps.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Armas Pharmaceuticals; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to qualify Avenacy, LLC as secondary source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to qualify Camber Pharmaceuticals Inc. as tertiary source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to monitor Caplin Steriles Limited and Eugia US LLC availability; requires P&T committee approval if pursued.

Not recommended: No allocation changes or clinical protocol adjustments at this time.
